issues.description: The problem statement requires students to implement `make_y_state(circ: stim.Circuit, q: int, p: float)`, but the template provides the stub under the different name `create_y_state(circ: stim.Circuit, q: int, p: float)`. This mismatch can cause `test_make_y_state` (and any student code following the prompt) to fail because the expected function name is missing from the template.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the template stub `create_y_state` to `make_y_state` (including updating the NotImplementedError text). Ensure any template or student-facing references use `make_y_state` to match the problem statement and reference solution.
